Coefficient Giving._sources: Initial baselines from EA historical grantmaking spreadsheet (as Open Philanthropy). Updated where scraped itemized grants exceed published totals (2017, 2019, 2021, 2023). 2024: Good Ventures 2024 report ($593M via OP recommendations incl $113M to GiveWell charities) + Coefficient Giving/Inside Philanthropy (>$100M from non-Good Ventures donors). Conservative estimate $650M. Open Philanthropy rebranded to Coefficient Giving in 2025. See DATA_SOURCES.md.
